entries.summary: Cyclomatic complexity measures paths through local control flow; it does not reveal duplicated authorization, lifecycle, or cross-repository meaning by itself.

evidence.note: The analyzer emits function and branch-line evidence only.
Refactor jobs carry related architectural-memory IDs separately from the numeric finding.

entries.decision: Use cyclomatic findings to locate investigation candidates, then consult architectural memory and verification before authorizing a refactor.
entries.next_trigger: Any new aggregate score must expose its factors and prove that it improves refactor selection on gold fixtures.
